note: Register of tabnas runtime dependencies that differ between this repository's ports (tabnas/admin ADR-24). tools/port-deps.cjs fails on a difference that is not listed here, and on an entry that no longer matches the manifests, so the list cannot outlive what it records. Every entry states the ports that have the dependency today, the reason, and the repair.

parser.reason: Go: go/error.go, lines.go, parser_source.go, rule_events.go and source.go import github.com/tabnas/parser/go (`NewParserSource` takes a `*tabnas.Tabnas`, `FailFromTabnas` a `*tabnas.TabnasError`, and the rule-event adapter reads `tabnas.Rule`, `tabnas.Context`, `tabnas.OrderedMap`, `tabnas.MapRef` and `tabnas.ListRef`), and go/go.mod requires it directly. Rust: rs/src/datum.rs (`Datum::from_tabnas`), rs/src/error.rs (`Fail::from_tabnas`) and lines.rs, mod.rs, parser.rs and rule_events.rs under rs/src/source/ use the engine crate (`ParserSource::new` takes a `tabnas::Tabnas`), with `tabnas` (package tabnas-parser) in [dependencies] of rs/Cargo.toml. TypeScript: no file in ts/src imports @tabnas/parser, value or type. `ParserSource` in ts/src/parser-source.ts types the parser it is given as `any`, ts/src/value.ts reads the engine's key order through its own `Symbol.for('tabnas.keyOrder')`, and ts/src/lines.ts gets its parsers from `require('@tabnas/csv')` and `require('@tabnas/json')`; the engine is a devDependency that only ts/test imports. The jsonic and parser peers were removed from ts/package.json on 2026-10-04 (tabnas/transduce#30).
parser.repair: To agree on having it: ts/package.json would list @tabnas/parser as a peer again, reversing tabnas/transduce#30, and ts/src could then type the parser as `Tabnas` where it now says `any`. To agree on not having it: the Go and Rust ports name the engine's types in their public signatures (`NewParserSource` in go/parser_source.go, `ParserSource::new` in rs/src/source/parser.rs), so neither can drop the dependency without changing that API. The TypeScript peer was removed under ruling 9 of the handover page in tabnas/parser (doc/handover/README.md); nothing there rules on whether the ports must agree. Undecided: awaits the maintainer's ruling.
